gaps.title: Missing UI for updating and deleting materials
gaps.jtbd: When maintaining the catalog, I want to update or delete existing epidemiological materials, so that the knowledge base accurately reflects the most current protocols without outdated entries.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an existing material in the system, When a user chooses to edit or delete it from the UI, Then the frontend invokes the corresponding PUT or DELETE API endpoint and the catalog is updated accordingly.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: The brief explicitly requires 'управления' (managing) materials, which encompasses updating and deleting, but the current UI only supports creation and reading.

gaps.title: Missing authentication and authorization mechanism
gaps.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access or modification.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material, Then they are blocked and prompted to log in.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: A knowledge base managing sensitive epidemiological data and protocols inherently requires a standard authentication and session mechanism.
